description.zh:
巡检项归属领域。取值：
- security：安全合规
- performance：性能效率 
- stability：业务稳定
- limitation：服务限制 
- cost：成本优化
description.en:
The category of the inspection item. Valid values:
- security: security and compliance
- performance: performance and efficiency 
- stability: business stability
- limitation: service limits 
- cost: cost optimization.

description.zh: 检查项过滤，为true仅返回result=true的异常检查项。
description.en: Specifies whether to filter check items. If set to true, only abnormal check items with result=true are returned.

The query language. Valid values:
- zh_CN
- en_US.

description.zh:
巡检项所属级别。取值：
- advice：建议
- warning：低危
- error：中危
- critical：高危
description.en:
The level of the inspection item. Valid values:
- advice: suggestion
- warning: low-risk
- error: medium-risk
- critical: high-risk.

description.zh: 每页最大条目数，最大值50。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

description.zh: 巡检对象类型，仅返回符合targetType的检查项。
description.en: The object type of the inspection target. Only check items that match the specified targetType are returned.

title.zh: 获取集群巡检报告详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs get-cluster-inspect-report-detail --cluster-id c82e6987e2961451182edacd74faf0000 --report-id 782df89346054a0000562063a0000 --biz-language zh_CN --category cost --target-type NodePool --level error --enable-filter true --next-token bb41e2bcb47b747389dce6c0d2 --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cs GET /clusters/c82e6987e2961451182edacd74faf0000/inspectReports/782df89346054a0000562063a0000 --region cn-hangzhou --level error --nextToken bb41e2bcb47b747389dce6c0d2 --maxResults 20 --enableFilter true --language zh_CN --targetType NodePool --category cost --header "Content-Type=application/json"
